_style: Flat cel-shaded 2D anime illustration with clean dark brown ink lines, one soft shadow tone per material, warm light from the upper left, matching the surrounding painting exactly. Not pixel art.

kaya.who: a young fire-nation woman with tan skin, amber eyes and dark brown hair

angry.text: Her face is angry and determined: brows drawn hard down and together, eyes narrowed, mouth a tight frown with clenched jaw

worried.text: Her face is worried and sad: inner ends of the brows raised and pinched upward, eyes wide and glistening looking slightly down, mouth small, closed and turned down

mira.who: an elderly earth-kingdom woman with deep brown wrinkled skin, dark brown eyes and white hair in a bun

warm.text: Her face is warm and kind: a gentle closed-mouth smile with the corners of the mouth lifted, cheeks raised, softened eyes with smile creases at the corners, brows relaxed; keep every wrinkle line style the same

thug.who: a rough bandit man with a red head scarf
